text:
elaine: FYI rolled a canary for session-prefix-consolidator. Short summary: p50 down ~22% on short convo flows, overall token compute per-request down ~13% on our mixed Llama/Mistral tracebench. p99 flat within noise in the first 8h.
rahul: Nice! What's the user-facing change?
elaine: Users should see snappier median replies for multi-turn chats where prefixes repeat. We consolidate near-identical session prefixes into a shared KV segment so fewer redundant KV ops.
kevin: Any regressions in tail latency or memory?
elaine: p99 stayed within +/-0.4%. Peak GPU working set reduced ~6% on small instances; no OOMs in canary. Cold-starts unchanged.
sara: How is this toggled and where is the canary running?
elaine: Flag: runtime.optimizations.session_prefix_consolidation = true. Canary targets: hosted-us-west + hosted-eu, ~3% pods. Dedicated remains opt-in only.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary created -> rollout id r-2026-14-session-prefix-consolidator; targets: hosted-us-west, hosted-eu (3% pods). Start: 2026-10-12T09:20Z. Monitor: https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/r-2026-14-session-prefix-consolidator
perf-bot: perf-bot: Auto-report (8h): p50 -21.6%, p90 -7.4%, p99 +0.2% (within expected variance). Estimated cost impact per 1M tokens: -13.2%.
rahul: Sounds solid. Any change to cache hit dynamics we should mention to support?
elaine: cache_hit_rate +3.5pp for repeat-session patterns, eviction_rate -14% in the canary shards. We also see fewer microbatch flush events which helps median latency.
kevin: Ops — please add dashboards and a short alert to watch for p99 creep if we scale the rollout.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Dashboard tile created: Runtime / Session Prefix Consolidator Canary -> https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/session-prefix-consolidator-canary. Alert rule recommended: p99 > baseline +1% for 30m.
docbot: docbot: Draft runtime note created (private): https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/session-prefix-consolidator (WIP). Will add flag docs, Dedicated opt-in checklist, and the A/B validation script.
sara: What validation do we require before Dedicated opt-in?
elaine: Run a 10k compatibility sweep across common models, verify p99 < +1% guardrail, mem/cold-start checks, and a short 24h A/B with customer workload if allowed. Ops checklist: monitor p50, p90, p99, cache_hit_rate, eviction_rate, microbatch_flush_count for first 48h.
rahul: Can we get a short blurb for the weekly product digest and a one-paragraph for support playbook?
elaine: Yep — I'll draft and post in #product and #support after finalizing changelog. TL;DR: solid median & cost win for conversational workloads; canary live on hosted 3%; Dedicated requires opt-in and extra validation. Ping me if you see anything odd. :rocket: :eyes:
